programme.title: On Your Wedding Day [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A story of the 10-year emotional roller-coaster romance repeating a cycle of love and heartbreak begun as the high school crushes.

programme.title: IP MAN 1 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A semi-biographical account of Yip Man, the first martial arts master to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun. The film focuses on events surrounding Ip that took place in the city of Foshan between the 1930s to 1940s during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Directed by Wilson Yip, the film stars Donnie Yen in the lead role, and features fight choreography by Sammo Hung.

programme.title: IP MAN 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Having defeated the best fighters of the Imperial Japanese army in occupied Shanghai, Ip Man and his family settle in post-war Hong Kong. Struggling to make a living, Master Ip opens a kung fu school to bring his celebrated art of Wing Chun to the troubled youth of Hong Kong. His growing reputation soon brings challenges from powerful enemies, including pre-eminent Hung Gar master, Hung Quan.

programme.title: IP MAN 3 [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

programme.title: MASTER Z: IP MAN LEGACY [English Dub]
programme.desc: Following his defeat by Master Ip, Cheung Tin Chi tries to make a life with his young son in Hong Kong, waiting tables at a bar that caters to expats. But it's not long before the mix of foreigners, money, and triad leaders draw him once again to the fight.

programme.title: Alienoid [English Dub]
programme.desc: In a collision of past and future, a swordsman pursues a sword, while in 2022, others seek an alien prisoner.

programme.title: Alienoid: Return To The Future
programme.desc: In ALIENOID: RETURN TO THE FUTURE, a shaman and a woman battle an alien commander with the Divine Blade.

programme.title: 12.12: The Day [English Dub]
programme.desc: The movie depicts the events that occurred on the night that changed the course of South Korea's history. Following the assassination of President Park Chung-hee on October 26, 1979, the citizens of Seoul had high aspirations for the democratization of their country. However, on December 12, Army Commander Jeon Doo-kwang and his allies staged a coup to seize power. The remaining army forces, led by Capital Defense Commander Lee Tae-shin, engaged in a confrontation with the rebels, putting the fate of the country and the lives of its citizens at stake.

programme.title: Miracle: Letters To The President [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: There is a village where you can only go if there is a railroad track, but there is no train station. Joon-kyung sends the 54th letter to the Blue House asking for a train station.

programme.title: My Worst Neighbor [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Seung Jin, an aspiring singer who prepares for an audition, moves into a new room after a long search. But, on his first night, he hears an unidentifiable sound - a sabotaging work of Rani, the next-door neighbor who has repeatedly evicted her neighbors after being bothered by their noise. After a bizarre noise war with a wall between them, they agree to share the time to make noises. As they share daily lives with their nameless, faceless neighbor, they develop feelings for each other.

programme.title: Sea Fog [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Written and produced by Bong Joon-ho (PARASITE, SNOWPIERCER, THE HOST), SEA FOG is a maritime thriller that captures the essence of why he is considered on of the most talented filmmakers working today. Upon learning that his decaying fishing trawler, the Junjin, is about to be sold, Captain Kang looks to make one final score by smuggling illegal immigrants from China to South Korea. After arriving at the agreed pickup point, a violent storm forces the Junjin to stall in open waters. As tension and unrest spread, Kang and his five-man crew find themselves pitted against their desperate passengers – all while an ominous fog envelops the ship and everyone onboard.

programme.title: Battle of Jangsari [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In the Korean War, inexperienced student soldiers face a critical mission to retake Incheon, altering history's course.

programme.title: Bad City [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Kaiko City is plagued with poverty and crime. When a corrupt businessman decides to run for mayor and starts eliminating opponents from the rival mafia, a former police captain serving time for murder is secretly released and put in charge of a special task force to arrest him.
